NVIDIA evaluating reduced HBM configurations with 8-layer stacks
Google launching TPU testing for space data center with SpaceX
Intel freezes hiring in PC chip division for minimum two weeks
NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs running OpenAI GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast with up to 8x faster token generation vs. Standard mode
TSMC and Oracle actively hiring engineers while HP and WeWork firing

implications.text: GPU architecture compromises driven by memory availability may limit next-generation performance scaling
Google-SpaceX collaboration represents infrastructure diversification strategy amid terrestrial capacity constraints
Hiring freeze signals margin pressure and reduced confidence in near-term PC segment demand
Laser shortage persistence threatens long-term datacenter scaling independent of compute chip availability

ko.counterpoint: Intel hiring freeze limited to two-week duration; longer-term implications remain unclear and may be contingent on market conditions.
